opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage with a confirmed publisher and scheduled publication date within three years.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country, researching 18th‑19th century British works on paper.

opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: £32,000 total (one year) or split over two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a master’s degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) at a UK institution, starting between April 2027‑April 2028.

opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
